label: D2 after a rare a2->S1 transition, following a rewarded trial (episode trials < 70)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S1 (a rare transition): 100% of activations are at D2 with in_action=a2 and in_state=S1. Within that, it requires the previous trial to have been rewarded (prev_reward=1, 100% of mass), and the previous choice not to be a1 (it is a2 or there is no previous trial in the window). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, on S2, or after an unrewarded previous trial. It also has a strong episode-time dependence: almost silent before trial 10, peaks at trials 20-60, and is silent from trial 70 on. Adding ep_trial<70 raises dev precision from 0.35 to 0.51 at recall 0.99. The remaining false positives look the same as true positives in the 5-trial window, so the leftover gating probably comes from slower hidden-state drift. Restricting the model value to 7.13-7.54 raises dev F1 to 0.73, but that value is a model readout, so it was not recorded. Every variable used is observed by D2. Magnitude was not mapped in detail: the top examples are mostly core or context rare a2->S1 trials after reward when S2 is good.
